output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, the latest dated short-interest report I could verify for Tonix Pharmaceuticals Holding Corp. (NASDAQ: TNXP) showed 2,940,708 shares short, with an October 15, 2026 settlement date. ChartExchange lists 17.21% short interest and 2.41 days to cover for that report. These are reported positions, not a live November 11 short-interest count.
caveats: I could not verify a newer settlement-date report; short-interest reporting is delayed.
ChartExchange labels 17.21% as “Short Interest %” without explicitly identifying its denominator, so it should not automatically be interpreted as a percentage of float.

Providers differ on percentage and days-to-cover metrics. StockAnalysis's page, updated November 11, also shows approximately 2.94 million shares short but different ratios and no short-interest settlement date.
